description: Version-keyed event topic shapes for receipt and refund events (issue #942). The single source of truth both contracts' topic-version tests consume through the generated fixture (see scripts/build-event-topic-vectors.mjs). Topic elements are tags: a bare word is a Symbol of that name, 'u64' is a u64 scalar position, 'bytes32' is a BytesN<32> position.
